description: 10 curated sample inputs and benchmark briefs for SitePilot AI across diverse industries, design languages, and layout strategies.

samples.brief: Create an energetic, high-contrast website for Zenith Fitness Studio, a premier boutique gym offering personal training, HIIT classes, and nutrition coaching. Include a hero section with a bold CTA to claim a free day pass, a features section highlighting certified coaches and 24/7 access, membership pricing tiers (Basic, Pro, Elite), client testimonials, and an appointment booking contact form.
sample_conversational_edits: Change the hero button text to Claim 7-Day Pass
Make buttons emerald green with #10B981
Align contact details to center

samples.brief: Design a warm, rustic, and welcoming website for Artisan Crust Bakery & Cafe. We specialize in naturally leavened sourdough breads, hand-laminated French pastries, and specialty espresso. Include an editorial hero with our baking philosophy, a showcase of our signature breads and pastries, morning breakfast combo pricing, customer reviews from neighborhood regulars, our opening hours and location, and an order inquiry form.
sample_conversational_edits: Change the primary brand color to warm terracotta #C2410C
Add an FAQ section about catering and gluten-free options before contact
Center align the contact details

samples.brief: Create a sleek, modern, dark-themed landing page for PulseFlow Analytics, a real-time event telemetry and analytics platform built for modern engineering teams. Highlight zero-latency event streaming, automated anomaly detection, and prebuilt dashboards. Include transparent developer pricing tiers (Hobby, Scale, Enterprise), CTO endorsements, and a contact form to book a live technical architecture demo.
sample_conversational_edits: Update the hero CTA button to Start Free Cloud Trial
Change the primary accent color to cyan #06B6D4
Make the hero section center aligned

samples.brief: Build a playful, trustworthy website for Paws & Claws Luxury Pet Resort. We provide gentle organic dog grooming, cage-free luxury boarding suites, and outdoor socialization daycare supervised by certified pet specialists. Include a friendly hero section, our key care amenities, grooming and boarding package rates, delighted pet parent reviews, and a reservation booking form.
sample_conversational_edits: Change the primary button color to #0D9488
Update the hero heading to Your Pet's Five-Star Vacation
Align the contact and location section to center

samples.brief: Create an elegant, minimalist portfolio website for Aura Interior Architecture, an award-winning residential and commercial interior architecture studio. Focus on timeless Scandinavian minimalism and biophilic organic spaces. Include an editorial hero, our design philosophy text section, signature project features, design consultation packages, press testimonials from Architectural Digest, and a project inquiry form.
sample_conversational_edits: Set the theme background to ivory #FFFDF9
Update the hero CTA link to #appointment-form
Add an FAQ section with 5 items before contact

samples.brief: Design a forward-looking, clean website for Helios Clean Energy Solutions, a provider of premium residential solar panels, smart inverters, and whole-home battery backup systems. Emphasize energy independence, 25-year warranty, and average 70% bill reduction. Include installation packages, homeowner reviews, and a free home solar audit request form.
sample_conversational_edits: Change the primary theme color to emerald green #10B981
Update the hero subtitle to Cut electricity bills by 70% with zero money down
Align contact section to center
